summary: Kenon Holdings Ltd. filed a 6-K reporting a collar transaction on 6 million OPC Energy Ltd. shares (≈2% of OPC). Kenon bought a put and sold a call with strike prices based on a reference price of NIS 124/share. No premium paid; 3-year term; settlement in cash or shares at Kenon's election. Kenon retains upside up to the call strike and limits downside, with shares posted as collateral. No board recommendation or advisor named. The transaction enhances financial flexibility and provides potential borrowing capacity. Watch for OPC share price relative to strike prices and any early termination events.
